summary: Two flagged events occurred on host-01 within a 15-minute window: a network scan at 15:00:00Z and a generic attack at 15:15:00Z.

sequence.description: A network scan was detected on host-01 at 2026-01-15T15:00:00Z.
A generic attack was detected on host-01 at 2026-01-15T15:15:00Z, 15 minutes after the scan.

findings.statement: A network scan was flagged on host-01, indicating potential reconnaissance activity.
A generic attack was flagged on host-01, indicating a potential compromise or malicious action following the scan.

impact: host-01 was targeted by a network scan and a subsequent generic attack, suggesting potential exposure or compromise of the host.
recommendations: Investigate host-01 for signs of compromise, including checking for unauthorized access, malware, or data exfiltration. Why: The sequence of a network scan followed by a generic attack on host-01 suggests a potential attack chain that may have led to compromise. Less disruptive option: Isolate host-01 from the network temporarily to prevent further damage while investigation is ongoing.

Review network logs and firewall rules to identify the source of the network scan and any other related activity. Why: Understanding the source and scope of the reconnaissance activity can help in identifying the attacker and preventing similar incidents.
